claim_label: Public fear of AI existential risk
description: A YouGov survey from 2025 found that more than one-third of respondents were concerned that AI would end human life on earth.

instances.assertion: A YouGov survey from 2025 found that more than one-third of respondents were concerned that AI would end human life on earth.
A YouGov survey found that over 33% of Americans are concerned that AI could end human life.
